title: Online & Local Services
page_title: Online and Local Services ICT - IGCSE Revision Notes

blocks.text: What are the advantages and disadvantages of online & local services?

blocks.md:
- The advantages and disadvantages of online & local services depends on the users **needs and preferences**
- They include:

  - **Urgency**
  - **Price**
  - **Choice**
  - **Online experience **

| Advantages | Disadvantages |
|---|---|
| **Convenience **- No travelling, can use anytime, anywhere | **Security **- Online scams, fraud and data breaches |
| **Selection **- Access to wider variety of options (local/national/international) | **Returns & exchanges** - Inconvenience caused when needing to return items, especially bigger items |
| **Competitive prices** - Online stores typically have lesser costs so can be very competitive with prices | **Delayed gratification** - Have to wait for items, can be frustrating |
| **Reviews & ratings** - Read customer reviews and see product ratings before purchasing | **Limited customer service** - Impersonal or difficult to reach compared to local businesses |

| Advantages | Disadvantages |
|---|---|
| **Immediate gratification** - No waiting for deliveries | **Limited selection **- Smaller selection compared to online |
| **Inspecting products** - Can check before purchasing | **Higher prices** - Higher overheads lead to higher prices |
| **Easier returns & exchanges** - Easier in person | **Travel & time** - Inconvenience/extra cost caused by travelling and waiting |
| **Supporting local economy** - Supporting local businesses/communities | **Limited access hours** - Limited opening hours |
